summary: A farmer's diary keeps the prices of grain, groceries and stock beside the events of the day.
realLife: Berte Emahizer logged crop yields and prices, grocery and farm prices and notable events; Hiram Young called wheat at forty-five cents a bushel too cheap.
sources: Kansas Historical Society, Berte Emahizer diaries finding aid: https://www.kansashistory.gov/p/berte-emahizer-diaries/20949
